description: Token and Vault Exit Ladder — One decision on holding a Base token and a vault position: token-trap-detector (live bytecode, proxy slots, honeypot simulation) and vault-exit-lawyer (redeem limits, queue, admin powers, eth_call simulation) run in parallel; contract-auditor then audits the token's verified source at the proxy implementation the trap step read, and is skipped on a honeypot or unverified source. Returns the worst

docsUrls.description: Public documentation pages whose redemption claims are checked against the contract.

exit.description: Exactly one of shares or assets, as base-unit integer strings. shares may be "max" (needs holder).

shares.description: Vault shares to redeem (base units), or "max" for the holder's whole balance.

holder.description: Address that holds the shares. Enables an exact eth_call redeem simulation and per-holder limits.

name: token-vault-ladder
